description:
The configuration profile, titled **Parental Control Time Limits Payload**, carries the same description and display name (“Parental Control Time Limits Payload”). It is identified by the bundle identifier **com.example.myprofile.timelimits**, issued by **Acme Corp**, and uses the payload type **com.apple.familycontrols.timelimits.v2**. The profile’s unique UUID is **A1B2C3D4-5678-90AB-CDEF-1234567890AB**, version 1, and family controls are enabled.

Time‑limit settings are defined for both weekdays (range type 0) and weekends (range type 1). On weekdays, the allowance is active, permitting **7200** seconds (2 hours) of use from **15:00:00** to **18:00:00**, while a curfew blocks access from **20:00:00** to **21:00:00**. On weekends, the allowance allows **14400** seconds (4 hours) between **10:00:00** and **14:00:00**, and a curfew restricts usage from **22:00:00** to **23:00:00**. All four sections—weekday allowance, weekday curfew, weekend allowance, and weekend curfew—are enabled.
